spans.s: तच्छीलादि the triad of senses तच्छील्, तद्धर्म and तत्साधुकारिन् possessed by the agent of an action, in connec- tion with which the affixes तृन् , इष्णुच् etc. are prescribed (cf
etc.) which (affixes) hence are called ताच्छीलिक; cf. अयं तच्छीला- दिष्वर्थेषु तृन् विधीयते, M. Bh. on

ताच्छब्द्य (1) use of a word for that word (of which the sense has been conveyed); the expression तादर्थ्या - त्ताच्छब्द्यम् is often used by gramma- rians just like a Paribhasa; cf. अस्ति तादर्थ्यात्ताच्छब्द्यम् । बहुव्रीह्यर्थानि पदानि बहुव्रीहि- रिति M. Bh. on
; similarly तृतीयासमास;for तृतीयार्थानि पदानि M.Bh. on
or समासार्थे शास्त्रं समासः M. Bh. on
; (2) use of a word for that word of which there is the vicinity; cf. अथवा साहचर्यात् ताच्छब्द्यं भविष्यति। कालसहचरितो वर्णः। वर्णॊपि काल एव; M. Bh. on
where the letter उ is taken in the sense of time required for its utterance, the reason being that sound and time go together; cf. also M.Bh. on
; (3) use of a word for that which resi- des there; cf. तात्स्थ्यात्ताच्छब्द्यं भविष्यति M.Bh. on
. At all the above places, the use of one word for another is by Laksana.
ताच्छीलिक prescribed in the sense of 'habituated'; a term used in con- nection with all affixes prescribed in the triad of senses viz. ताच्छील्य, ताद्धर्म्य, तत्साधुकारित्व in Sutras from
